slots.jd.residential-builder.about: Fieldstone Builders is an owner-run residential builder in Lancaster, PA. We build homes with our own crews, and the work is on site. We are looking for a Master Carpenter to run the carpentry on our jobs, from layout and framing through finish work, and to help train the people coming up in the trade.
slots.jd.residential-builder.duties:
What the job involves
- Direct carpentry crews on site and assign daily tasks
- Train apprentices and check their work
- Keep the site safe and make sure everyone follows safety rules
- Order lumber and materials and track deliveries
- Read plans and lay out each job before work starts
- Check finished work against the plans before other trades come in
slots.jd.residential-builder.needs:
What you need
- 9 or more years of carpentry experience
- Rafter cutting, stair building and concrete forming
- Door and window installation, subfloor installation and cabinet installation
- Lead Carpenter Certificate (required)
- Crew Supervisor Certificate (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Leads framing of walls and floors on home remodels, cutting rework by 20 percent through careful checks before sheathing goes on.
slots.r1.b2: Enforces jobsite safety on every remodeling site, checking ladders, tools and walkways with the crew before work begins.
slots.r1.b3: Sets doors, windows and trim on remodels and handles concrete forming for new steps and thresholds, reducing installation callbacks by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Plans jobs and orders lumber ahead of each phase, scheduling scaffold erection so exterior work starts without delays.
slots.r1.i1: At Marlow Remodeling, frames walls and floors for home remodels and checks the work of the crew.
slots.r1.i2: Builds and sets forms for concrete footings, slabs and steps on remodeling projects at Marlow Remodeling.
slots.r2.b1: Built forms for concrete stair landings and handled stair building on framing jobs, cutting form setup time by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Ordered lumber and materials for each job based on careful layout and measuring, keeping waste and return trips low.
slots.r2.b3: Framed walls and floors and handled rafter cutting for roof systems, raising daily framing output by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Kept work areas safe during door and window installation by bracing openings and clearing debris from walkways.
slots.r2.i1: Built forms for concrete footings and walls as part of the framing crews at Harlow Framing Company.
slots.r2.i2: Kept framing sites safe at Harlow Framing Company while working as a journeyman on walls, floors and roofs.
slots.r3.b1: Installed doors, windows and trim after framing rough openings, cutting installation time by 45 percent under journeyman guidance.
slots.r3.b2: Read plans and took measurements for layout while following jobsite safety rules on tools, ladders and cuts.
slots.r3.b3: Assisted with concrete forming for footings and walls, reducing form material waste by 10 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Ordered lumber and materials for jobs, including the planks and frames needed for scaffold erection.
slots.r3.i1: Learned to keep the site safe at Tillman Brothers Carpentry while training as an apprentice carpenter.
slots.r3.i2: Helped order lumber and materials for jobs at Tillman Brothers Carpentry during a carpentry apprenticeship.
slots.summary.1: Master carpenter with 9 years of experience planning jobs and checking the work of crews and apprentices. Skilled in layout and measuring, framing and jobsite safety, and holds a Lead Carpenter Certificate.
slots.summary.2: Carpentry professional at master level with about 9 years in the trade, planning jobs from layout to finish and checking the work of others. Brings hands-on skill in layout and measuring, framing and jobsite safety on remodeling and framing sites.
